sentences.text: Ferganasaurus is a genus of sauropod dinosaur named after the Fergana Valley.
This animal reached a length of 18 meters and an estimated mass of 15 tonnes.
Known remains include a partial postcranial skeleton featuring two long claws on each hand.
Additional material attributed to the genus includes spatulate teeth similar to those of Jobaria.
The original holotype fossils were lost, leaving only drawings of the remains.
No skull or cranial bones have ever been found for Ferganasaurus.
The species Ferganasaurus verzilini was formally described in 2003 by Alifanov and Averianov.
The holotype specimen was discovered in 1966 by Kurzanov and Rhozdestvensky.
A second specimen was found during a 2000 expedition in the Balabansai Formation.
Ferganasaurus is considered similar to Rhoetosaurus, which reached about 19 meters in length.
Ferganasaurus verzilini is the only known species in the extinct genus Ferganasaurus.
Ferganasaurus is classified as an eusauropod sauropod dinosaur.
The parent group for Ferganasaurus is Eusauropoda.
Ferganasaurus belongs to the class Saurischia.
Ferganasaurus lived approximately 160 million years ago during the Middle Jurassic in what is now Asia.
Fossils were found in the sediments of the Balabansai Formation.
Ferganasaurus lived between 165.3 and 161.5 million years ago during the Callovian age.
